findings.what: Setting key={JSON.stringify(state.values)} remounts the whole form after each submit, so keyboard/screen-reader focus is lost and does not move to the first invalid field.
A thrown insertContactMessage (DB error) is not caught; the visitor gets a generic error boundary and loses the typed input instead of a friendly message.
node:sqlite needs Node >=22.5 but package.json has no engines field; older runtimes fail at runtime.
